messages:
claire: opening a PR to consolidate the 'hello-serve' quickstart into a single compact page. plan: add SDK v5 snippets (node + python), keep curl for reference, swap env var to REDWOOD_KEY, and add a deploy button. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/550

ram: sounds good. please standardize on REDWOOD_KEY and include a one-line SDK v4->v5 migration hint. also add a 1-line troubleshooting note for 401s.

jason.d: quick asks: bump node examples to 20, target python 3.11, and add a short CORS/security pointer for browser tries.

claire: done. switched to REDWOOD_KEY, added migration callout, node:20, py:3.11, and a CORS one-liner (link to Security guide). kept the whole quickstart to one screen.

doc-bot: spelling check: 'onboardingg' -> 'onboarding' at step 2.

claire: fixed the typo and pushed.

ci-bot: linkcheck failed: 1 broken link -> /docs/old-button.html (404)

claire: replaced with /docs/deploy/buttons and updated deploy badge to /deploy?repo=redwood-inference/hello-serve. also compacted example responses to single-line JSON: {"id":"r_77","output":"Hi"}.

ram: editorial nit: use the phrase 'deploy button' across the copy. and add the short 401 snippet (export REDWOOD_KEY=sk_test_xxx).

claire: added FAQ snippet for 401s and normalized wording.

jason.d: reviewed and approved. no technical blockers.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #550 (checks: lint, mdx-compile, linkcheck) :white_check_mark:

claire: merging now so this can hit staging in the next deploy. :rocket:
